description: Reads a conversation, oldest first, ending with the latest message (or the last before the time given in before). Images appear as [image <id>] with their message's id; pass both as message and image to see the picture.

before.description: Only messages before this time (ISO 8601), to read further back

image.description: To see an image: the image's id

limit.description: At most this many messages (default 50, up to 200)

machine.description: The machine to use, by name, as the machines tool lists it. Leave it out when only one machine offers this tool.

message.description: To see an image: the message's id

name: messages_read
title: Read a Conversation
